svg.title: The muon's magnetic anomaly: measurement minus Standard Model prediction
svg.desc: Bar chart. The measured magnetic anomaly of the muon minus the Standard Model prediction, in units of 10^-11. In 2021 the Fermilab and Brookhaven average exceeded the 2020 White Paper prediction by 251 ± 59, a tension of 4.2 standard deviations. With the 2025 White Paper prediction, which took the leading hadronic term from a lattice-QCD average, and the final Fermilab average, the difference is 38 ± 63, no tension. Data: Muon g-2 Collaboration, Phys. Rev. Lett. 126, 141801 (2021); Aliberti et al., Phys. Rept. 1143 (2025).
